capabilities: Lock and unlock notes via view-header icon, command palette, banner, or file menu
Block all edits in Live Preview and Source mode, including typing, paste, drag-and-drop, and undo
Prevent writes from other plugins such as Templater and linters while a note is locked
Store the lock as a frontmatter property so it syncs with the note
Optionally allow automatic link updates after file renames or moves
extras: Not yet accepted into the community plugin directory and not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; README notes AI (OpenAI Codex) assisted development and that screenshots predate a rename from Note Lock. Requires Obsidian 1.5.7+. Locking only protects against edits inside Obsidian, not sync services or external tools.
intentEvidence: like Notion's "lock page", but for Obsidian
motivation: Modeled on Notion's 'lock page' feature, brought to Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to protect a note from accidental or plugin-driven edits while keeping it readable.

relations.evidence: Page Lock replaces this project's former note-lock plugin ID.
Simple Gallery 1.8.4+ can also update image destinations inside gallery fences through a scoped Page Lock integration.

summary: Note-locking plugin that makes a note read-only via a frontmatter property, blocking editor edits and writes from other plugins.
